mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.POST_SEQ) FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_SAVE S JOIN moa.TB_COMM_POST P ON P.POST_SEQ = S.POST_SEQ JOIN moa.TB_RCP R ON R.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ JOIN moa.TB_USR U ON U.USR_ID = P.USR_ID WHERE S.USR_ID = #{usrId} AND P.POST_STAT IN (#{postActive}, 'ACTIVE') AND ( P.VIS_TYP IN (#{publicVisibility}, 'PUBLIC') OR P.USR_ID = #{usrId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM moa.TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID = #{usrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID = P.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT IN (#{followAccepted}, 'ACCEPTED') ) )

SELECT P.POST_SEQ AS "postSeq" , P.POST_TTL AS "title" , P.POST_CN AS "description" , R.RCP_CTG_CD AS "categoryCode" , CT.COM_DTL_DESC AS "categoryName" , R.COOK_MIN AS "cookingMinutes" , R.SERV_QTY AS "servings" , R.RCP_DIF_CD AS "difficultyCode" , DF.COM_DTL_DESC AS "difficultyName" , P.USR_ID AS "authorId" , U.NCK_NM AS "authorName" , U.PRFL_IMG_FIL_SEQ AS "profileImageFilSeq" , TO_CHAR(P.POST_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_LIKE L WHERE L.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ) AS "likeCount" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_SAVE S WHERE S.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ) AS "saveCount" , EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST_SAVE S WHERE S.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ AND S.USR_ID = #{usrId} ) AS "savedByMe" , (P.USR_ID = #{usrId}) AS "mine" FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST P JOIN moa.TB_RCP R ON R.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ JOIN moa.TB_USR U ON U.USR_ID = P.USR_ID LEFT JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL CT ON CT.COM_CD = 'RCP_CTG' AND CT.COM_DTL_CD = R.RCP_CTG_CD LEFT JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL DF ON DF.COM_CD = 'RCP_DIF' AND DF.COM_DTL_CD = R.RCP_DIF_CD WHERE P.POST_SEQ = #{postSeq} AND P.POST_STAT IN (#{postActive}, 'ACTIVE')

SELECT RI.SORT_ORD AS "sortOrd" , RI.INGR_SEQ AS "ingrSeq" , RI.INGR_GRP_CD AS "ingredientGroupCode" , RI.INGR_CD AS "ingredientCode" , COALESCE(IC.COM_DTL_DESC, RI.INGR_NM_SNAP) AS "ingrName" , RI.INGR_AMT AS "ingrAmt" , RI.UNIT_CD AS "unitCode" , UC.COM_DTL_DESC AS "unitName" , RI.NOTE AS "note" FROM moa.TB_RCP_INGR RI LEFT JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL IC ON IC.COM_CD = RI.INGR_GRP_CD AND IC.COM_DTL_CD = RI.INGR_CD LEFT JOIN moa.TB_COM_CD_DTL UC ON UC.COM_CD = 'RCP_UNIT' AND UC.COM_DTL_CD = RI.UNIT_CD WHERE RI.POST_SEQ = #{postSeq} ORDER BY RI.SORT_ORD
SELECT S.STEP_NO AS "stepNo" , S.STEP_CN AS "content" , S.COOK_SEC AS "cookSec" , S.STEP_FIL_SEQ AS "stepFilSeq" FROM moa.TB_RCP_STP S WHERE S.POST_SEQ = #{postSeq} ORDER BY S.STEP_NO

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moa.TB_COMM_POST P JOIN moa.TB_RCP R ON R.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ WHERE P.POST_SEQ = #{postSeq} AND P.POST_STAT IN (#{postActive}, 'ACTIVE') AND ( P.VIS_TYP IN (#{publicVisibility}, 'PUBLIC') OR P.USR_ID = #{usrId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM moa.TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID = #{usrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID = P.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT IN (#{followAccepted}, 'ACCEPTED') ) )
